meta.decision: Phase 197: tests/golden/wire_dict_baseline.json is preserved byte-unchanged. This file is the committed, reviewable expected-delta list the three datasheet-cited Fujitsu pulse corrections in tools/datasheet_overrides.json produce on top of it -- the golden itself is never re-captured or re-baselined to make this phase's change disappear.
meta.honesty: This layer records that these three records' pulse-delay wire value moved from the pre-197 decoded figure to the datasheet-cited one. It does not by itself prove any of the three values is correct: two of the three (FUJITSU/MBM27128 and FUJITSU/MBM27C1001) rest on datasheet AC-characteristics tables read visually by a human researcher from scanned pages, not on an independent electrical measurement. The third (FUJITSU/MBM27C1000) was measured the same way in an earlier plan of this phase. Phase 197 also moved 10 other database fields -- 9 unsupported_reason strings and RAMTRON/FM1608's electrical.type and electrical.vcc_mv -- and this measurement, run against the live capture, confirms none of those 10 reaches the wire: the 9 unsupported_reason rows are adapter-required and never produce a wire dict, and vcc/type are asserted elsewhere (test_vcc_and_vpp_volts_never_cross_the_wire) to never cross the host-to-wire seam.
meta.how_to_update: This layer is regenerated by the same script against the live database and never edited by hand. A new delta must name the chips and the reason in the commit message. Growing this list without a provenance justification is exactly the re-baselining the decision above exists to prevent -- see tests/test_wire_dict_equivalence.py's composition test for the anti-laundering assertions this fixture must satisfy.
meta.provenance: All three records are attributable to tools/datasheet_overrides.json entries: FUJITSU/MBM27128 (programming.pulse_duration_us 200 -> 1000, citing datasheets/MBM27128.pdf, Figure 3 Quick Pro TPW = 1 ms +/- 50 us) and FUJITSU/MBM27C1001 (100 -> 500, citing datasheets/MBM27C1001.pdf, AC CHARACTERISTICS tPW 0.475/0.50/0.525 ms), both added in plan 197-05; FUJITSU/MBM27C1000P,MBM27C1000 (100 -> 500, citing datasheets/MBM27C1000.pdf, AC CHARACTERISTICS tPW 0.475/0.50/0.525 ms), added in plan 197-02. No record here is attributable to the FM1608 electrical.type/vcc_mv change or to any of the 9 unsupported_reason string changes -- measurement against the live capture confirmed those 10 database-row changes contribute zero wire deltas. Generated programmatically from the live capture against the committed golden plus the 149, 153, 182 and 194 delta layers -- never transcribed by hand, since the |<i> record-key suffix is a positional index within each manufacturer's list and would silently rot if any row is ever added or reordered.
